t: A free KDE app for ear training with intervals, chords, scales, and rhythm.
steps: Install Minuet from a Linux package manager, Flathub, or the Microsoft Store on Windows.
Use the KDE nightly build on a Mac. Only nightly builds exist for Mac.
Connect speakers or headphones to each computer.
Connect a microphone for the singing exercises.
Ask IT to approve the install.
Set the tempo, instrument, and test length for your class.
Try one interval exercise before class.
